title: Statistical analysis code for lower-than-expected peak expiratory flow and chronic lung disease recognition in HRS and CHARLS
description: Statistical analysis code for parallel survey-weighted longitudinal analyses in the Health and Retirement Study and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study. The archive contains code only and excludes manuscripts, participant-level data, derived data, aggregate results, and personal information.
keywords: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study
